title: TruthWeaver tool configuration
description: The truthweaver.json file: defaults for the truthweaver command line and terminal UI. A command-line option wins over this file, and this file wins over the built-in defaults. The tool reads enumeration values with any case.

operatorStyle.description: The operator spelling for printed output. Default: word.

constantStyle.description: How printed output writes True, False and Unknown. When absent, each printer uses its own default: letters for equations and truth tables, word for rule text and trees.

dialect.description: The notation of printed equations. Default: unicode.

theme.description: The color set of the terminal workbench. auto asks the terminal for its background and uses dark when it does not answer. Default: auto.

limits.description: Compile limits. Each default is the compiler default.

maxAnalysisTerms.description: The maximum number of distinct terms that the analysis considers. Default: 20.

maxRewriteNodeCount.description: The maximum node count of a rewrite result. Default: 100000.

schemaFile.description: The path of the optional predicate schema file, relative to the directory of this file.
